what: PlanarMap API shape (user decision 2026-10-20): every function taking a vertex or edge handle returns {:ok, …} or {:error, :unknown_vertex | :unknown_edge}, with a bang twin that raises ArgumentError. Code that just created its handles (figure builders) uses the bang twins so threading stays a plain pipe, e.g. map |> PlanarMap.insert_edge!(a, b). Functions taking only points or transforms (insert_vertex/2, transform/2, scale, translate, replicate, weld) return bare values.
why: Handles go stale after remove_vertex, after weld, or across maps. That is caller-supplied input, so per AGENTS.md only bang functions may raise on it.
